name: KIN
category: A tiny creature that lives with you
tagline: A tiny friend under your real sky.

capture.command: npm run dev & sleep 5; KIN_PICK="iphone/01-meadow=1,iphone/03-play=2,iphone/05-snow=3,iphone/06-night=3,iphone/07-card=1,iphone/08-cocoon=3,ipad/01-meadow=0,ipad/03-play=2,ipad/05-snow=4,ipad/06-night=3,ipad/07-card=4,ipad/08-cocoon=2,cross=1" node scripts/store-shots.mjs all
capture.notes: scripts/store-shots.mjs drives the real app bundle headless (Playwright from ../outatime-88, real GPU via Metal) at 1320x2868 and 2064x2752, with Playwright's clock set so sky and HUD time agree. The crossing (02-cross-a/b) uses embed mode: two real instances side by side, Lumi visits Nox. The KIN roams, so each scene is a burst of candidates in store/lobby/cand/ (gitignored); KIN_PICK records which one became the raw. A fresh run picks different moments: look at the candidates and update KIN_PICK. Real GPU (Metal) only: SwiftShader is too slow and shots come out dim.

shots.title: A tiny friend that *lives with you*.
shots.sub: Hatch your KIN. It grows up in a little world under your real sky.

shots.title: Hop onto a *friend's screen*.
shots.sub: Two screens side by side. Your KIN walks to the edge and hops across.

shots.title: Your weather, *its world*.
shots.sub: Snow, rain, wind and sunsets follow the sky where you are.

shots.title: Flick the ball. _Play fetch._
shots.sub: Throw toys, pick berries, pet and brush. No menus in the way.

shots.title: Day turns to *starlight*.
shots.sub: Its sun and moon move with your clock.

shots.title: Watch your bond *grow*.
shots.sub: Affection, energy and mood, in rings you can read.

shots.title: Tap twice. *Meet them.*
shots.sub: Every KIN hatches different, with its own name and nature.
